The classic Zombies experience! Fight to survive wave after wave of progressively harder Zombie ROUNDS - killing enemies and earning POINTS to BUY WEAPONS, PERKS, UPGRADES, and DOORS to each area of the map.

4 DIFFICULTY MODES are available - CASUAL if you're new to Zombies, NORMAL for the experienced, HARDCORE for the veterans, and REALISTIC if you want to feel the teeth in your flesh!

Of course, each map holds its SECRETS. Items and Quests lay hidden for those determined to uncover them, and with each step, the mysteries of Chaos and Aether wait to be revealed! The hidden MAIN QUESTS are central to the story of each map, and are accessible only in Normal, Hardcore, and Realistic difficulties.

Network Address Translation (NAT) is a way to map an entire network to a single IP address. This is a common way of doing networking in most home or work environments.

Your NAT type is Strict. A moderate NAT may experience problems connecting to other players who also have Strict NATs.

The game tried to use UDP port &&1 to open the required port for an open NAT in-game.

Depending on your router, you may be able to enable Universal Plug and Play (UPnP), port forwarding or add your PC to demilitarized zone (DMZ) to get the NAT type to appear Open in game, which will provide the best experience for connecting with other players.

Because of the wide variety of 3rd party routers and unique networking set-ups, neither Treyarch^BBUTTON_REGISTERED_SYMBOL^ nor Activision^BBUTTON_REGISTERED_SYMBOL^ can offer direct technical support for NAT related issues.
